_why: Vasco re-voiced (the user, 24 Oct: 'overly exaggerated, sometimes whispers without a reason ... more natural'). New tags for js/lines.js: how the line is spoken, conversational, normal volume; stage business and the whisper/breathless tags taken out. Lines not listed keep their text (24 had no tags). Seven takes that still came out soft (4-7 dB under the rest before levelling: the shy and sad tags) were redone with no tag or a warm one.
vasco_hello: [warmly] Doctor Vasco Teles. Curator of the treasury and, today, the man in the hole. Please don't step on the Moors.
vasco_rope: That's very kind. Mind the rope.
vasco_pit: [interested] A bell-casting pit, 1730s. Founders dug them right beside the church: you don't carry a three-ton bell across Lisbon.
vasco_bottom: [keen] You have to see the bottom. That's where it gets interesting.
vasco_lanyard: [a little thrown] Is that... a professional concern?
vasco_busy: [cheerfully] Sorry, I've found a sherd. There is always a sherd.
vasco_much_1: [awkwardly] I, ah. Should we... get some air?
vasco_little_1: You're bored. I should check the reserve, actually.
vasco_much_2: [clears throat] That's... the heat down here. It's very hot. For a pit.
vasco_dirt: [warmly] You've got eighteenth-century clay on your face.
vasco_much_3: [awkward laugh] That is not conservation practice.
vasco_little_3: Right. Yes. A tissue. There are tissues in the reserve, I'll just...
vasco_much_4: [flustered] I... the sentence was about coins.
vasco_little_4: [a bit cooler] To a historian. Speaking of things of value, did I lock the reserve?
vasco_quiet: [warmly] It's very quiet down here. Two hundred years of quiet.
vasco_ladder: I'll just pop up and check on things.
vasco_stall: [calling out] Moorish! Everybody gets that wrong! [sheepish] Where were we?
vasco_kiss: [a little dazed] I've never kissed anyone in a scheduled monument.
vasco_card: The Roman layer's open on Thursdays. Private viewing.
vasco_fragment: Your family's. It came up after you'd gone. I thought you should have it.
vasco_sleep: [concerned] You look like a man who hasn't slept. Is everything all right?
vasco_shirt_1: [embarrassed] Oh, God. Since six this morning. I dressed in the dark, and nobody said a word.
vasco_shirt_3: [warmly] Thank you. That was... very kind.
vasco_inscription_1: [excited] Writing? Where? Oh! Oh, you've got good eyes. Hold on, it's tiny, let me get my nose right down to it...
vasco_inscription_again: [cheerfully] All right, once more. Look, the letters are cut backwards, like a seal...
vasco_inscription_2: [reading slowly] 'I. S. fez.' 'J. S. made this.' A founder signing his own pit. [delighted] Your family again, Senhor Sanches.
vasco_lookup: [surprised] Sorry, what are you doing with your arm?
vasco_warm_1: [laughs] A cat that keeps things. I'd like to meet him. Look, here, where the colour changes: that's where the Moors stop.
vasco_cool_1: [politely] Let's... keep the dating to the pottery, shall we?
vasco_warm_2: [delighted] Luck! Founders threw coins in the melt for a sweeter tone. Nobody ever asks the right question, and you keep doing it.
vasco_why: Sorry. I've been talking about bricks for twenty minutes. Nobody ever asks why I do this.
vasco_warm_3: [sincerely] Because everyone down here was somebody's whole world, and nobody wrote their names down. I like to give them back a date, at least.
vasco_cool_3: [cooly] Right. Yes. I'm sure you can.
vasco_sus_3: There's one by the museum door. Next to the reserve. Which I should check on, actually.
vasco_warm_4: [laughs] That's the nicest thing anyone's ever said about my hole. [pause] That came out wrong.
vasco_roman: Come and look. This is the Roman floor. Nobody has stood on it for sixteen hundred years.
vasco_hook_2: [hurt] ...So that's why you were so interested in my buttons.
vasco_vcall_3: [sincerely] I wanted to see what you'd do with a second chance. Most people waste them.
vasco_fcall_3: [uneasy] You sound like a man saying goodbye.
vasco_fcall_4: [gently] The floor's still down there. Sixteen hundred years, and it hasn't moved. It will be there on Thursday.
vasco_fcall_5: [serious] Then come back for it. Be careful, Senhor Sanches.
vasco_forgive: [sighs] It was a very good distraction. What do you need?
vasco_what: [wary] Honestly? Now I'm worried. What do you need?
vasco_come_down: [pause] Fifty-six. Nobody's asked for that box in forty years. Come on. Mind your head on the stairs.
vasco_tag: 'Clapper. Bronze. Provenance unknown. Deposited nineteen fifty-six.' [pause] In your grandfather's hand. I've walked past it every day for six years.
vasco_store_loan: [serious] It's on loan. To a scholar. [pause] You'll bring it back. And you'll owe me.
vasco_dust: [warmly] You've got dust on your face.
vasco_not_here: [firmly] Not here. Not like this. [pause] Not while you're still keeping something from me.
vasco_thursday_truth: Thursday, then. Bring the coffee. And the truth.
vasco_thu_pause: [pause] ...You put a museum piece in a murderer's shop.
vasco_thu_catalogue: Clapper. Bronze. Provenance... known. [pause] [moved] I've never been able to write that before.
vasco_thu_down: Then come downstairs. The reserve is quiet before ten.
vasco_love_1: This is where I nearly kissed you. You were keeping something from me.
vasco_love_2: [amused] I know. You haven't made a single joke since the coffee. I've been counting.
vasco_love_tie: [laughs] It's a museum tie. It's catalogued.
vasco_after_1: [chuckles] I'm going to have to catalogue this.
vasco_after_3: [chuckles] And him. Back on his shelf by Monday. Nobody will ever know he left.
vasco_hook_3: [dry] ...So that's why you were so interested in my buttons.
vasco_liar: [fondly] You're a terrible liar, Senhor Sanches. Don't change.
vasco_idle_7: My mother thinks I dig for the Church. I dig for the people the Church forgot.
vasco_idle_18: [surprised] You're still here. That's... fine. Good, actually.
